--- text
The quick b|rown fox jumps over the lazy dog
--- width
20
--- keys
Up
--- expect
|The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
--- note
The exact inverse of fixture 21. There, Down on the LAST visual row (which has
no row below) falls back to moveToLineBoundary forward and lands at the line
end. Up on the FIRST visual row (which has no row above) is the mirror: it must
fall back to moveToLineBoundary backward and land at the line start.

At width 20 the line wraps to three rows and the caret sits on row 1 ("The
quick brown fox "). mdVerticalArrowKeymap tries moveVertically up, gets the same
head (document top), and returns false, so CM6's default cursorByLine runs; its
own moveVertically also cannot move, so it falls back to
moveToLineBoundary(range, false), the start of row 1, which is offset 0. This
matches macOS moveUp on the first line. The caret must reach offset 0, not stay
put at column 11, and not jump elsewhere.
